title: Marc Andreessen & Jack Altman: Venture Capital, AI, & Media

thesis: The speakers discuss the historical shift in venture capital from funding 'picks and shovels' tool companies to backing 'full stack' startups that directly enter and replace entire industries, citing Uber and Airbnb as the turning points around 2010. They argue that modern venture capital is a customer service business serving both limited partners and founders, where the market naturally directs capital to the best opportunities regardless of fund size.
